The Japanese yen strengthened 0.51 per cent to 157.33 per dollar.  The Swiss franc, another traditional safe haven, was little changed at 0.824 per dollar. The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, rose 0.14 per cent to 101.82, with the euro down 0.3 per cent at $1.1198. The dollar has become increasingly tied to capital flows and to growth and inflation expectations linked to the AI trade. It fell last week as fears over the AI outlook grew. On Thursday, however, concerns about France outweighed those fears. “You have these competing stories and weak points between US AI-related credits and then France sovereign credit, and we've seen this push and pull in the last couple of days where at times one is more of a concern than the other,” said Erik Nelson, global head of FX strategy at Wells Fargo. “As long as France is more of a concern than US AI credits, then you're going to see the euro underperform.” French President Emmanuel Macron vowed on Wednesday to prevent a repeat of last weekend's violence at protests planned in the coming days, and dismissed as "stupid" and "unacceptable" comments from some foreign leaders about the unrest. Concerns about France's ability to manage its huge debt burden have hurt French government bonds and raised worries about other heavily indebted euro zone countries. The spread between France and Germany's 10-year note yields reached 177.7 basis points on Thursday, the widest gap since 2011. Sterling weakened 0.18 per cent to $1.337. The Australian dollar fell 0.21 per cent to $0.7012. In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 3.20 per cent to $81,929.  (Additional reporting by Amanda Cooper and Tom Westbrook; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Former presidential candidate Gonzalez arrested in Ecuador
item.description: Ecuador's former presidential candidate Luisa Gonzalez has been arrested, the head of the leftist Citizens Revolution party, Gabriela Rivadeneira, said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ecuador's former presidential candidate Luisa Gonzalez has been arrested, the head of the leftist Citizens Revolution party, Gabriela Rivadeneira, said on Thursday. Gonzalez, an ally of former President Rafael Correa, is under investigation over alleged irregularities in political financing and campaign spending. She has previously said that her party submitted its 2023 presidential campaign spending to the electoral authority and that the prosecutor's office has no evidence to support its accusations. Gonzalez lost the snap election to President Daniel Noboa. "They arrested Luisa Gonzalez. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH!," Correa shared on X.

item.title: Consejo Superior de Deportes español pide a tribunal que revise dichos de jefe de LaLiga sobre Real Madrid
item.description: El Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD) pidió a un tribunal deportivo que considere las declaraciones del presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, en que comparó la estrategia de comunicación del Real Madrid con la propaganda nazi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Consejo Superior de Deportes (CSD) pidió a un tribunal deportivo que considere las declaraciones del presidente de LaLiga, Javier Tebas, en que comparó la estrategia de comunicación del Real Madrid con la propaganda nazi. El CSD solicitó al tribunal que evalúe si las declaraciones pueden haber infringido las normas que protegen la dignidad y el decoro deportivos. Tebas hizo los comentarios el viernes en las redes sociales y, en respuesta, el Real Madrid emitió un comunicado en el que pedía la dimisión inmediata de Tebas, de 64 años. Tebas dijo que no estaba comparando la ideología del Real Madrid ni la de su afición con las del Partido Nazi, sino únicamente las técnicas de propaganda del club. Las sanciones por este tipo de infracciones incluyen amonestaciones, multas o posibles suspensiones. LaLiga no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios.

item.title: Shell- and Exxon-backed UK chemicals group weighs $8 billion sale, FT reports
item.description: Infineum, a UK-based chemicals group backed by Shell , is exploring an $8 billion sale, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, as the energy major tries to refocus on its core oil and gas operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Infineum, a UK-based chemicals group backed by Shell (SHEL.L) , is exploring an $8 billion sale, the Financial Times reported on Thursday, as the energy major tries to refocus on its core oil and gas operations. The chemicals group, which is owned by Shell and ExxonMobil (XOM.N) as a 50:50 joint venture, has tapped advisers at Bank of America to run a sale of the business, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. The companies are aiming for a roughly $8 billion valuation from a sale that could attract interest from private equity suitors, the report said, adding that the process remains in the early stages and may not result in a transaction. Shell declined to comment on the report, while Exxon, Infineum and Bank of America did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: 米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る
item.description: [ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米新規失業保険申請6000件減の19.4万件、約57年ぶり低水準に迫る 10/22 22:46 配信

米バージニア州アーリントンにある店舗に掲げられた求人看板。2023年4月撮影。REUTERS/Elizabeth Frantz

[ワシントン　２２日　ロイター] - 米労働省が２２日発表した１０月１７日までの週の新規失業保険申請件数（季節調整済み）は前週比６０００件減の１９万４０００件となった。レイオフ（一時解雇）の少なさを背景に、申請件数は１９６９年以来の低水準となった７月中旬の１８万９０００件に迫る水準にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２０万件だった。

週ごとの変動をならした４週間移動平均は１０００件減の１９万７７５０件と、１９６９年以来の低水準となった。

エコノミストらは、堅調な内需を背景に企業収益が伸びていることに加え、退職の増加やトランプ政権による移民取り締まりで労働力人口が縮小していることが、労働者を解雇から守っていると指摘している。ただ、中東紛争の長期化に伴う金融環境の引き締めや金利上昇が、来年の労働市場に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとの懸念もある。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「政権の移民政策により労働市場は逼迫し、企業は財（モノ）・サービスの生産に必要な人手を確保できなくなっているため、既存の労働者を手放さない状況になっている」と指摘。「多くの産業において、突如として労働者が代替不可能な存在となっている」と述べた。

今回の申請件数データは、１０月の雇用統計の調査期間と重なっている。

１０月１０日までの１週間の継続受給件数（季節調整済み）は２万５０００件増の１７２万８０００件となった。 ただ、継続受給件数には、大学を最近卒業した人や、職歴が浅い、または全くないために受給資格がない人は含まれていない。

長期失業者の一部が、大半の州で２６週間に制限されている受給資格を使い果たした可能性もあり、これが継続受給件数が低水準で推移する一因となっている可能性がある。９月の失業期間の中央値は１１．５週と、約４年半ぶりの高水準に近いものの、９月の失業率は４．２％にとどまっており、労働市場がインフレの要因とはなっていない。

ハイ・フリークエンシー・エコノミクスのチーフエコノ ミスト、カール・ワインバーグ氏は「米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は、需要を抑制しスラック（需給の緩み）を拡大して、インフレ目標回帰を確実にするために金融引き締めが必要と判断すれば、来週にも自由に利上げに踏み切ることができる」と指摘。「雇用に関するＦＲＢの責務は明らかに満たされている」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：ＡＩ信奉の誤算、米メタ　大規模リストラ縮小し「人間中心」に回帰 アングル：米雇用統計、利下げ観測復活の試金石に　ＦＲＢはなお慎重 アングル：3月米雇用統計、ＦＲＢの金利据え置きシナリオの補強要因に 焦点：ＡＩが10万人以上の雇用に影響か、米映画業界でリスキリング活況 アングル：試される米消費の持続力、物価高に政府閉鎖や雇用情勢悪化で 最終更新: 10/23(金) 0:09 ロイター

item.title: Nasdaq lidera queda em Wall Street em meio a apreensões com IA; preços do petróleo se recuperam
item.description: O índice Nasdaq, com forte peso de empresas de tecnologia, recuava mais de 2% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que as ações de crescimento perdiam força depois que os resultados financeiros das megacapitalizadas Tesla e Meta não conseguiram dissipar as preocupações relacionadas à IA, com a recuperação dos preços do petróleo contribuindo ainda mais para o mal-estar do mercado.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Ragini Mathur
item.content:encoded: O índice Nasdaq, com forte peso de empresas de tecnologia, recuava mais de 2% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que as ações de crescimento perdiam força depois que os resultados financeiros das megacapitalizadas Tesla e Meta não conseguiram dissipar as preocupações relacionadas à IA, com a recuperação dos preços do petróleo contribuindo ainda mais para o mal-estar do mercado. Essa queda segue uma sessão forte na quarta-feira, quando Nasdaq liderou a alta em Wall Street, à medida que resultados robustos da SpaceX (SPCX.O) e da Super Micro (SMCI.O) reacenderam o otimismo em torno das ações ligadas à IA. SpaceX caía 3,9% e Super Micro recuava 3,4% nesta quinta-feira, à medida que os investidores olhavam para além dos resultados financeiros e avaliavam os custos crescentes dos investimentos em IA e o prazo incerto para o retorno desses investimentos. Tesla (TSLA.O) caía 1,9% depois que a fabricante de veículos elétricos reduziu a previsão de gastos de capital anuais, levantando dúvidas sobre o ritmo de suas ambições em IA e robótica. Separadamente, a Reuters noticiou com exclusividade que alguns executivos da Tesla estão preocupados de que os comentários públicos do presidente-executivo Elon Musk sobre uma possível fusão com a SpaceX possam atrair o escrutínio dos acionistas e complicar as negociações do acordo. As ações da meta (META.O) caíram 6,7% depois que a gigante das redes sociais lançou novas ações sem direito a voto para ajudar a financiar sua dispendiosa expansão em IA. “O que torna essas empresas de IA mais vulneráveis é justamente o fato de já terem avaliações tão altas. Portanto, qualquer pequeno tropeço no mercado causará uma grande queda em algumas dessas ações”, disse Brendon Dashiell, gestor de portfólio de pesquisa de investimentos da Bogart Wealth. “Acreditamos que os mercados continuarão instáveis, mas ainda estamos cautelosamente otimistas.” Outras empresas do grupo “7 Magníficas” também registravam quedas, com a Amazon.com (AMZN.O) e a Nvidia (NVDA.O) caindo cerca de 2% cada. As ações do setor de chips também caíam. Intel (INTC.O) registrava queda de 5,3%, enquanto AMD (AMD.O) , Qualcomm (QCOM.O) , Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) , Broadcom (AVGO.O) e Micron Technology (MU.O) recuavam entre 1,9% e 5,2%. O renovado nervosismo fez com que o Índice de Volatilidade da CBOE (.VIX) subisse 17,86 pontos, após três pregões consecutivos de quedas. Seis dos 11 setores do S&P 500 registravam perdas, liderados pelo setor de tecnologia (.SPLRCT) , que caía 1,6%. Os índices de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) e de saúde (.SPXHC) , no entanto, eram os que mais se valorizavam, à medida que os investidores buscavam setores defensivos. Às 11h44 (horário de Brasília), O Dow Jones (.DJI) caía 310,68 pontos, ou 0,59%, a 52.545,41 pontos. O S&P 500 (.SPX) tinha queda de 104,17 pontos, ou 1,34%, a 7.653,00 pontos, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) recuava 575,73 pontos, ou 2,15%, a 26.127,12 pontos. O petróleo Brent oscilava próximo do maior valor em cinco meses, depois que novos ataques de militantes houthis na Arábia Saudita alimentaram temores de interrupções no abastecimento e de um conflito mais amplo no Oriente Médio. A busca por ativos seguros empurrou o rendimento dos Treasuries de 10 anos para cerca de 5,0378%.

item.title: Sports Council refers LaLiga's Tebas to tribunal over Real Madrid comments
item.description: The National Sports Council (CSD) has referred LaLiga chief Javier Tebas to Spain's sports tribunal after his comparison of Real Madrid's communication strategy to Nazi propaganda.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The National Sports Council (CSD) has referred LaLiga chief Javier Tebas to Spain's sports tribunal after his comparison of Real Madrid's communication strategy to Nazi propaganda. The CSD has asked the tribunal to assess whether the remarks may have violated rules protecting sporting dignity and decorum. Tebas made the [USN:L6N4620UQ TEXT:"comments"] on Friday on social media and in response Real released a statement asking for the 64-year-old's immediate resignation. Tebas said he was not comparing the ideology of Real or their fan base with those of the Nazi Party but merely the club's propaganda techniques. On Thursday, the CSD said it had raised the issue with the sports tribunal. The CSD asked the sports tribunal to assess whether Tebas' statements were a "potential violation of Article 76.4.b of Law 10/1990 on Sport, which classifies 'notorious and public acts that infringe upon sporting dignity or decorum' as serious infractions." Sanctions for such infractions include warnings, fines or potential suspension. Tebas responded on social media shortly after the CSD made its referral public, again making the distinction between ideology and propaganda techniques in his Friday comparison. Tebas also said the CSD could use Real's questioning of LaLiga's integrity as grounds for a similar referral. "Defending the competition also requires responding to those who constantly discredit it," wrote Tebas. "It's part of my responsibility. And I'm going to keep exercising it." Reuters has asked Real Madrid for comment.

item.title: StoneX vê salto de 7% no consumo de biodiesel no Brasil, se mistura subir a 16% em 2027
item.description: Um eventual avanço na mistura de biodiesel no diesel no Brasil de 15% para 16% em 2027 elevaria a demanda pelo biocombustível em 7% ante 2026, para 11 bilhões de litros, de acordo com o primeiro estudo da consultoria StoneX para o próximo ano, divulgado nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Roberto Samora
item.content:encoded: Um eventual avanço na mistura de biodiesel no diesel no Brasil de 15% para 16% em 2027 elevaria a demanda pelo biocombustível em 7% ante 2026, para 11 bilhões de litros, de acordo com o primeiro estudo da consultoria StoneX para o próximo ano, divulgado nesta quinta-feira. A StoneX acrescentou, contudo, que o cenário para aumento da mistura de biodiesel é incerto, dependendo de uma decisão governamental. "A expectativa é de que os testes para viabilidade até o B20 (mistura de 20%) sejam concluídos em fevereiro/27 e, a partir dos resultados obtidos, o aumento para o B16 poderia se materializar a partir de março", disse um relatório assinado pelos especialistas da StoneX Bruno Cordeiro dos Santos e Isabela Garcia. Mas eles ponderam que não há sinais claros do governo "de que estaríamos caminhando nessa direção", apesar de a indústria ter capacidade de sobra, com uma ociosidade estimada pela consultoria para 2027 em 40%. Um aumento da mistura poderia impulsionar a indústria de soja, uma vez que o óleo de soja é de longe a principal matéria-prima para a produção de biodiesel no Brasil. A associação do setor Abiove estimou nesta quinta-feira que as exportações do grão brasileiro [USN:L1N4680IN TEXT:"podem cair em 2027"], em meio ao crescimento do processamento doméstico, considerando uma mistura maior. Dados da ANP citados pela StoneX indicam que a commodity representou cerca de 85% da produção do biocombustível, registrando alta de 8,2% frente a 2025. Sem avanço na mescla, o crescimento nas vendas de biodiesel no Brasil seria de 1,2% em 2027, para 10,43 bilhões de litros, basicamente acompanhando o consumo do mercado de combustível. A StoneX estimou ainda a demanda brasileira por diesel B, com mistura de biodiesel, em 71,4 bilhões de litros em 2027, alta anual de 1,2%. A consultoria comentou que nos cenários, de B15 ou B16, o óleo de soja deve registrar crescimento de participação, "uma vez que a capacidade do setor de esmagamento em atender o biodiesel é compatível com o crescimento das vendas, enquanto outras matérias-primas, apesar de também registrarem volume maior, não acompanham a competitividade do óleo". O esmagamento de soja estimado exclusivamente para a produção de biodiesel em 2027 subiria para 43,7 milhões de toneladas, versus 41 milhões em 2026, no caso de um B16. Com uma mistura mantida em 15% no ano que vem, o processamento da oleaginosa avançaria para 41,4 milhões de toneladas. A demanda por óleo de soja para biodiesel subiria para 8,7 milhões de toneladas, para atender um B16 em 2027, versus 8,3 milhões com um B15, ante 8,2 milhões em 2026, segundo cálculos da StoneX.

Suspected spy for Russia arrested in Germany

Oct 22 (Reuters) – A Ukrainian national has been arrested in the German state Brandenburg on suspicion of spying for Russia, a statement by federal public prosecutors said on Thursday.

Germany has stepped up efforts to counter what it sees as escalating hybrid attacks from Moscow, deemed by Chancellor Friedrich Merz the biggest threat to his country’s security.

The suspect, identified by prosecutors as Vadym Y. under German privacy rules, had been in contact with a Russian secret service via an intermediary since at least July 2025, prosecutors said.

Show Full Article

Prosecutors said he gathered military-related intelligence, including information on the production of armoured vehicles, ammunition and explosives, as well as personnel and installations involved in securing NATO’s eastern flank.

While some of the information was publicly available, other details were solicited from individuals in the European defence industry, they said.

The Russian embassy in Berlin did not immediately reply to a request for comment.

MOUNTING THREAT

Merz said on Thursday the arrest did not surprise him and warned that there would be more such cases in the future.

Western officials have warned for months that Russia is mounting sabotage, cyber and other hybrid attacks across Europe to erode support for Ukraine.

Merz said on Wednesday that Russian disinformation campaigns and hybrid operations posed the greatest threat to Germany’s security, adding that Moscow was mounting a broader challenge to the political order established after the Cold War.

The suspect is due to appear before an investigating judge at Germany’s Federal Court of Justice on Friday, when he will be formally presented with the arrest warrant and a decision will be made on whether he remains in pre-trial detention.

(Reporting by Kirsti Knolle; additional reporting by Cian Muenster and Miranda Murray; writing by Linda Pasquini; editing by Matthias Williams and Ros Russell)

item.title: Anthropic IPO stands alone as AI market jitters sideline others
item.description: A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic.
item.dc:creator: Echo Wang
item.content:encoded: A once-robust fall calendar for technology IPOs is down to just Anthropic. The AI lab is pressing ahead to hold its initial public offering as planned in the middle of next month after making its prospectus public as early as late October, people familiar with the matter said, cautioning the plan and the dates are subject to change. Anthropic's planned IPO will test whether its position at the center of the booming AI business, which the company is believed to deem worthy of a potential $1.5 trillion valuation, can overcome a market environment that might typically prompt bankers and deal lawyers to counsel delay. Anthropic is expected to begin marketing its shares to prospective investors during the week of November 9, one of the people said. Other companies in the artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center sectors have delayed their listings, facing a rise in interest rates that has helped fuel a punishing selloff in shares and bonds of AI operators such as CoreWeave (CRWV.O) and broader questions about the sustainability of AI spending. The contrast underscores Anthropic's appeal to investors even as concerns about competition from open-source models and AI safety weigh on the sector. Many large investors remain bullish on Anthropic’s prospects despite the fall turbulence, viewing the firm as one of the few opportunities to gain exposure to a technology sector that long-term investors cannot afford to ignore. Other issuers are reluctant to compete with Anthropic for institutional investors' attention and capital, two of the people said. Anthropic didn't immediately respond to a request for comment. VALUATIONS COMING UNDER PRESSURE The AI sector pullback follows a string of IPO delays and withdrawals since September, as market volatility and rising interest rates have made it harder for companies to secure attractive valuations. Switch, a data center operator, and Nscale, an AI infrastructure provider, have pushed their IPO plans back to later this year, people familiar with the matter said, while stressing that plans remain fluid and subject to change. Nscale’s delay was partly driven by the need to address comments from SEC staff, one other person said. SoftBank-backed SB Energy has also postponed its listing, Reuters previously reported. Switch, NScale and SB Energy didn't immediately respond to requests for comment. South Korean AI chip startup Elice was among the latest to shelve its listing plans overnight. Blackstone-backed AirTrunk REIT and Nvidia (NVDA.O) -backed Firmus have also pulled or paused their offerings, Reuters has reported. Oura's recent IPO has added to the caution among prospective issuers. The offering attracted little participation from long-only investors, a person familiar with the matter said, raising concerns about the depth of demand from institutional investors that typically provide a stable base of shareholders for newly listed companies. SCRUTINY ON MULTIPLE FRONTS The retreat from AI infrastructure listings reflects growing scrutiny of the enormous capital required to build data centers and whether future demand will justify the investment. Recent developments involving CoreWeave have added to concerns about a potential slowdown in AI spending, although some market participants do not expect such a downturn to materialize. Nscale publicly filed its IPO registration statement in September, while Switch submitted its filing confidentially, Reuters reported previously. A confidential filing allows a company to work with regulators on its registration statement before disclosing financial and business details to the public. Companies typically publish the filing ahead of investor roadshows, when they begin marketing shares to prospective investors.

item.title: AbbVie's skin disease drug reduces lesions in trial, company eyes weight-loss combination
item.description: AbbVie said on Thursday its experimental drug significantly reduced inflammatory lumps and abscesses in patients with a chronic skin disease, meeting the main goal of a late-stage study.
item.dc:creator: Christy Santhosh
item.content:encoded: AbbVie (ABBV.N) said on Thursday its experimental drug significantly reduced inflammatory lumps and abscesses in patients with a chronic skin disease, meeting the main goal of a late-stage study. AbbVie is betting on the drug, lutikizumab, to broaden its immunology franchise, and supplement the growth from its blockbuster drugs Skyrizi and Rinvoq. The company expects to begin testing lutikizumab alongside its experimental weight-loss drug, [USN:L4N3YF1R0 TEXT:"ABBV-295"], by the end of the year, AbbVie's immunology head, Kori Wallace, told Reuters. The combination aims to address obesity, which can worsen the skin condition. Lutikizumab was tested in patients with hidradenitis suppurativa, or acne inversa, a condition marked by small, painful lumps to form under the skin. In the 1,400-patient trial, about 31% of patients treated with lutikizumab achieved at least a 75% reduction in inflammatory skin lesions after 16 weeks, compared with 23% of those on placebo. BMO Capital Markets analyst Evan Seigerman said the drug's efficacy appears clinically meaningful, but may be directionally lower than competitors such as Belgian drugmaker UCB's (UCB.BR) Bimzelx and Merck's (MRK.N) experimental drug [USN:L4N45M10F TEXT:"tulisokibart"]. COMBINATION OPPORTUNITIES AbbVie licensed its weight-loss drug ABBV-295 from Danish biotech Gubra in 2025. It's designed to mimic amylin, a hormone that helps regulate appetite and food intake. "Majority of patients with HS are obese and that weight actually drives worse disease activity. Bringing down weight with our anti-inflammatory could really lead to increased efficacy in patients," AbbVie's Wallace said. The company is also testing Rinvoq, its arthritis and inflammatory bowel disease drug, in hidradenitis suppurativa, with late-stage trial results expected by the end of 2026. Wallace said the company sees an opportunity for lutikizumab both as a standalone treatment and as part of a "one-two punch" with Rinvoq in HS. RBC Capital analysts expect the market for hidradenitis suppurativa treatments to exceed $10 billion by 2035.

WASHINGTON, Oct 22 : The US Commerce Department said on Thursday it plans to award $389 million in research and development funding to four companies working on power semiconductor devices and critical materials to boost technologies like commercial fusion. As a condition of funding, the US government will receive minority, non-controlling and non-voting equity stakes, the department said. In recent months, it has awarded 19 R&D grants to semiconductor firms from a $10 billion fund approved by Congress in 2022. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said in a statement the awards will "accelerate American semiconductor innovation to enhance our domestic energy and power resources." Reuters first reported the new funding. The department said it had signed letters of intent to provide four new awards:

• Washington-based Helion will receive up to $175 million to develop high-voltage power semiconductors and advanced energy power modules in fusion power generation. The semiconductors will power and use energy from magnets driving Helion fusion generators. Helion said the award will be accompanied by $50 million in new private investment funds. "Building fusion power plants at scale requires us to accelerate the development of technologies like semiconductors that are critical to making fusion possible,” said Helion CEO David Kirtley. • Massachusetts-based Commonwealth Fusion Systems will receive up to $85 million to develop semiconductors for radio-frequency plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and radiation-hardened electronics. • Commonwealth said the funding will help develop semiconductor technologies for robotic maintenance systems. "These innovations will be a vital part of our global effort to deploy commercial fusion," Commonwealth CEO Bob Mumgaard said. • Vertical Semiconductor will receive up to $73 million to advance its vertical gallium nitride power semiconductors for use in AI data center racks. The company, a startup spun out of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, said the funding will help accelerate R&D of next-generation power transistors and speed domestic production of this technology to drastically improve efficiency and power density for AI data centers and critical energy infrastructure. • Sibelco North America will receive up to $56 million to develop next-generation purification for ultra-high-purity quartz used in the semiconductor supply chain. Sibelco North America, part of Belgium parent Sibelco, said the funding for key quartz components in semiconductor manufacturing will be used for next-generation leaching technologies and a demonstration facility to support testing new products in North Carolina. Sibelco CEO Hilmar Rode said announcement "represents a significant step for Sibelco and reflects the importance of high purity quartz within the semiconductor manufacturing supply chain"

Oct 22 : England captain Harry Brook smashed the fastest double ton in One-Day International history and became the first Englishman to score 200 in the format as he powered his side to 429-4 against Sri Lanka in their tri-series match in Rawalpindi on Thursday. The 27-year-old rewrote the record books by racing to his double hundred in 114 balls, surpassing the previous mark of 117 deliveries set by India's Shubman Gill. In the process, Brook also eclipsed England's highest individual ODI score of 182, held by all-rounder Ben Stokes. Brook's scintillating performance ended with the final ball of England's innings when he was caught by Sahan Arachchige off the bowling of Janith Liyanage.

item.title: WHO, Africa CDC say Nigeria Ebola patient not confirmed to have visited Congo
item.description: The World Health Organization and Africa's top health agency said on Thursday they had not received confirmed information that Nigeria's Ebola patient had travelled to Congo, after Ugandan authorities said the woman had also visited the neighbouring country before being diagnosed.
item.dc:creator: Clement Bonnerot, Anait Miridzhanian
item.content:encoded: The World Health Organization and Africa's top health agency said on Thursday they had not received confirmed information that Nigeria's Ebola patient had travelled to Congo, after Ugandan authorities said the woman had also visited the neighbouring country before being diagnosed. Nigerian health authorities have said the country's first Ebola case in [USN:L6N4670RQ TEXT:"more than a decade"] involved a Ugandan woman who had recently returned from Uganda. Uganda's health ministry said the woman had also travelled to Congo, where the outbreak was first declared in mid-May and has since become the [USN:L6N4421DF TEXT:"fastest-spreading"] on record. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention official Wessam Mankoula said Nigeria and Uganda were sharing information to establish the patient's movements and possible source of exposure. "So far, there is no validated information (that) this case traveled to DRC (Democratic Republic of Congo)," Mankoula told an online press conference. The WHO said information it had received about the case did not include travel outside Uganda. "The facts which we have received is that the patient returned to Abuja on October 3, being away from September 16 in Uganda," WHO representative to Nigeria Pavel Ursu told the press conference. Ursu said the focus in Nigeria was now on containing the viral infection and that the patient remained hospitalised, with her biochemical markers improving. Jean Kaseya, Africa CDC director, told Reuters on Wednesday that the patient, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat, arrived in Abuja after a two-week holiday in Uganda. Patrick Otim, a WHO emergency response manager, said on Thursday the source of her infection was still unknown as health authorities were working to piece together her travel history. One issue that is under investigation is which health facilities the woman visited in Abuja after the onset of her symptoms and before her hospitalisation 48 hours later, Otim said. KENYA TRACES ALL CONTACTS OF FIRST CASE Separately, a senior Kenyan health official said authorities there had now traced all 135 contacts of the country's first Ebola case, which was [USN:L8N45S0GY TEXT:"confirmed on October 6"] and after which a further eight cases have been reported. "We have been able to account for them 100%," health ministry director-general Patrick Amoth said. He said the last contact to be traced was a citizen of Uganda who had arrived in Kenya in early October on the same flight as the index patient but exited by road via the Namanga border post with Tanzania, which meant it took more time to find him. Africa CDC is investigating whether the Kenyan case may have come into contact with the patient being treated in Nigeria, as both travelled from Entebbe airport on the same day, Mankoula said. Possible transmission between the two was "one of the possible scenarios" being examined, he said. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. The rare Ebola species behind the current outbreak kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine. So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people across the four African countries that have reported cases, according to the Africa CDC.

item.title: US weekly jobless claims near 57-year lows amid low layoffs
item.description: The number of Americans filing new claims for unemployment benefits dropped to near 57-year lows last week amid low layoffs, suggesting job growth picked up in October after September's underwhelming performance.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: The number of Americans filing new claims for unemployment benefits dropped to near 57-year lows last week amid low layoffs, suggesting job growth picked up in October after September's underwhelming performance. The weekly jobless claims report from the Labor Department on Thursday, the most timely data on the economy's health, continued to show no material stress in the labor market from the oil price shock stemming from the US-Israeli war with Iran. Economists say strong growth in profits amid robust domestic demand, and a smaller workforce against the backdrop of retirements and an immigration crackdown by the Trump administration, were shielding workers from layoffs. There are, however, worries that tightening financial conditions and higher interest rates because of the drawn-out Middle East conflict could undercut the labor market next year. "The administration's immigration policies may have tightened up the labor markets where companies are unable to find the help they need to produce their goods and services so they are holding tight to the workers they have," said Christopher Rupkey, chief economist at FWDBONDS. "Workers are suddenly irreplaceable in many industries." Initial claims for state unemployment benefits fell 6,000 to a seasonally adjusted 194,000 for the week ended October 17. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 200,000 claims for the latest week. It was the sixth consecutive week that claims remained at or below the 200,000 mark. Claims are within striking distance of the 189,000 level touched in mid-July, which was the lowest reading since 1969. The four-week moving average of claims, seen as a better measure of labor market trends as it irons out week-to-week volatility, dropped 1,000 to 197,750, the lowest level since 1969. The claims data covered the period during which the government surveyed business establishments for the nonfarm payrolls component of October's employment report. The four-week average of claims fell between the September and October survey weeks, suggesting a pickup in payrolls this month. Payrolls increased by 29,000 [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"jobs in"] September after rebounding by 133,000 in August. Payrolls tend to underperform when Labor Day falls relatively late in the month as was the case in September. Economists continue to view the labor market as still in a "low-hire, low-fire" state. But uncertainty from the war and tariffs on imports has stymied hiring. Financial markets were little moved by the claims data. HIRING REMAINS SLUGGISH The claims report showed the number of people receiving unemployment benefits after an initial week of aid, a proxy for hiring, increased 25,000 to a still-low seasonally adjusted 1.728 million during the week ended October 10. The so-called continuing claims, however, do not include recent college graduates and others who are ineligible for benefits due to little or no work history. Some long-term unemployed people may have exhausted their eligibility, which is limited to 26 weeks in most states, keeping continuing claims at low levels. The median duration of unemployment was 11.5 weeks in September, near a 4-1/2-year high. Still, with the unemployment rate at 4.2% in September, the labor market is not a source of inflation. Economists said that reduced the need for the Federal Reserve to aggressively tighten monetary policy as it battles the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"inflation fallout"] from the Middle East conflict. The US central bank in September raised its [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"overnight benchmark interest rate"] by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range. Economists expect the Fed to stay pat at its meeting next week and hike borrowing costs again in December. "The Fed has a free hand to hike rates next week if it deems monetary tightening necessary to soften demand and increase slack to ensure a return to the inflation target," said Carl Weinberg, chief economist at High Frequency Economics. "Its employment mandate is clearly satisfied." (This story has been corrected to clarify that the four-week moving average of claims was at its lowest level since 1969, in paragraph 6.)

Oct 22 : Indian digital trust services provider eMudhra on Thursday said it would voluntarily withdraw from the global SSL/TLS certificate business, following an incident in which its digital certificates were found to have vulnerabilities. The disclosure of the vulnerabilities led to internet browser majors such as Google, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft to block digital certificates issued by eMudhra, and sparked larger concerns among cybersecurity professionals around internet security and privacy. SSL and TLS are protocols used to secure data sent between web browsers and servers, ensuring that private information cannot be intercepted by bad actors. eMudhra issues these certificates to digital businesses and government agencies, including for some online public services such as India's income tax portal. An independent cybersecurity researcher found over the weekend that several key certificates issued by eMudhra, used to secure websites, software, and online communications, were weak and vulnerable to attack.

On Wednesday, India's Computer Emergency Response Team also issued an advisory saying that some of eMudhra's intermediate certificates were compromised. The company, in its statement on Wednesday, said it withdrew eight certificates it had issued, and that its infrastructure was not compromised and no data was breached. The level of social media amplification around the incident has brought scrutiny that is out of proportion with the significance of the vertical in the company, eMudhra said in its follow-up statement, adding that the global SSL/TLS certificate business contributes 1 per cent of its revenue. eMudhra's customers include Indian IT services companies Infosys and TCS. Shares of the company fell 40 per cent in the two days after the vulnerability was disclosed.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Tesla drops as spending pullback clouds AI, robotics ambitions
item.description: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: Tesla’s shares slid five per cent in premarket trading on Thursday as the EV maker’s reduced capital spending forecast raised questions about the pace of investment behind Elon Musk’s AI, robotics and autonomous-driving ambitions. The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about US$20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow. The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX. But “investors are likely to come away with mixed feelings,” J.P.Morgan analysts, led by Rajat Gupta, wrote in a note. “The delay helps near-term cash burn but also suggests delays in investments that matter for fruition of long-term opportunities.” Wednesday’s management commentary suggested spending will be ramped up in 2027 and 2028 as Tesla continues to fund robotaxi, Optimus, AI compute and Terafab milestones, the brokerage said. Tesla’s shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq’s roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December 2025. Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors. “The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles,” said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell. (Reporting by Joel Jose in Bengaluru; Editing by Joyjeet Das)

item.title: El yen se dispara por la preocupación por el petróleo, la IA y Francia
item.description: El yen se encaminaba el jueves a anotar su mayor subida diaria en casi un mes, porque los inversionistas lo buscaban como refugio ante la inestabilidad de los mercados bursátiles, los altos precios del crudo por la guerra en Oriente Medio y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad futura de la inteligencia artificial (IA).
item.dc:creator: Karen Brettell
item.content:encoded: El yen se encaminaba el jueves a anotar su mayor subida diaria en casi un mes, porque los inversionistas lo buscaban como refugio ante la inestabilidad de los mercados bursátiles, los altos precios del crudo por la guerra en Oriente Medio y las dudas sobre la rentabilidad futura de la inteligencia artificial (IA). * En tanto, el dólar estadounidense se apreciaba frente al euro, porque la preocupación por los disturbios sociales en Francia y el deterioro de las perspectivas fiscales del país pesaban más que las inquietudes sobre el sector de la IA, que provocaba una caída de las acciones estadounidenses. * "La IA está poniendo nerviosa a la gente, al igual que el petróleo... y Francia. Es evidente que hay un ligero grado de aversión al riesgo en el mercado", dijo Chris Scicluna, de Daiwa Capital Markets. * El petróleo Brent tocó un máximo no visto desde mayo después de que nuevos ataques hutíes en Arabia Saudita avivaron el temor a una escalada del conflicto en Oriente Medio y a nuevas interrupciones en el suministro. * El yen japonés se apreciaba un 0,51%, a 157,33 unidades por dólar. * El franco suizo, otro refugio tradicional, se mantenía prácticamente sin cambios en 0,824 unidades por dólar. * El índice dólar , que mide la cotización de la moneda estadounidense frente a una cesta de seis divisas que incluye al yen y al euro, subía un 0,14%, a 101,82, mientras que el euro bajaba un 0,3%, a 1,1198 dólares. * La preocupación sobre la capacidad de Francia para gestionar su enorme deuda ha perjudicado a los bonos del Estado francés y ha avivado el temor por otros países muy endeudados de la zona del euro. El diferencial entre los rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años de Francia y Alemania alcanzó los 177,7 puntos básicos el jueves, la mayor diferencia desde 2011.

item.title: Insider: Evonik prüft Übernahme von US-Rivale Ashland
item.description: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik prüft zwei Insidern zufolge eine Übernahme des US-Konkurrenten Ashland. Zwei mit den Bestrebungen vertraute Personen sagten am Donnerstag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters, Evonik sei einer von mehreren Interessenten für das Unternehmen, das an der New Yorker Börse mit 3,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet wird. Ashland habe auf Druck von aktivistischen Investoren begonnen, nach Interessenten Ausschau zu halten, sagte einer der Insider. Der Prozess - und damit die Bemühungen von Evonik - hätten noch vor dem Vorstoß von BASF zur Übernahme des Essener Konzerns begonnen. Das Vorgehen sei daher nicht als "Giftpille" zur Abwehr von BASF zu sehen. Evonik wollte sich dazu nicht äußern, Ashland war für eine Stellungnahme zunächst nicht zu erreichen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Spezialchemiekonzern Evonik (EVKn.DE) prüft zwei Insidern zufolge eine Übernahme des US-Konkurrenten Ashland (ASH.N) . Zwei mit den Bestrebungen vertraute Personen sagten am Donnerstag der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters, Evonik sei einer von mehreren Interessenten für das Unternehmen, das an der New Yorker Börse mit 3,3 Milliarden Dollar bewertet wird. Ashland habe auf Druck von aktivistischen Investoren begonnen, nach Interessenten Ausschau zu halten, sagte einer der Insider. Der Prozess - und damit die Bemühungen von Evonik - hätten noch vor dem Vorstoß von BASF (BASFn.DE) zur Übernahme des Essener Konzerns begonnen. Das Vorgehen sei daher nicht als "Giftpille" zur Abwehr von BASF zu sehen. Evonik wollte sich dazu nicht äußern, Ashland war für eine Stellungnahme zunächst nicht zu erreichen. Das "Handelsblatt", das als Erstes über das Interesse an Ashland berichtet hatte, schrieb, Evonik wolle mit einem Zukauf in den USA die Abhängigkeit vom europäischen Markt verringern, Ashland passe gut in die Strategie, da sich die Portfolios unter anderem bei Kosmetik-Inhaltsstoffen und Spezialadditiven ergänzten. Neben Evonik hätten auch Finanzinvestoren wie Advent, Apollo (APO.N) und Carlyle (CG.O) Kontakt zu Ashland aufgenommen. Evonik habe die Investmentbanken Perella Weinberg und JP Morgan beauftragt, den Markt nach geeigneten Zielen zu sondieren. Bei Ashland gehören drei als aktivistisch eingeschätzte Investoren nach LSEG-Daten zu den zehn größten Anteilseignern: Standard Investments (9,9 Prozent), Omega Advisors (6,4 Prozent) und Ancora Advisors (4,3 Prozent). Letzterer ist inzwischen mit zwei Vertretern im Verwaltungsrat von Ashland vertreten. Die Ashland-Aktie legte am Donnerstag nur leicht auf 72,46 Dollar zu. Evonik würde mit einer Übernahme von Ashland größer und könnte damit von BASF schwerer zu verdauen sein. Ob sich der Ludwigshafener Chemieriese davon stören ließe, ist offen. BASF-Chef Markus Kamieth warb am Donnerstag in einer [USN:L8N4681R4 TEXT:"Videobotschaft"] mit weitreichenden Job- und Standortgarantien um Evonik und dessen Eigentümer. Ein Zusammenschluss sei eine "starke deutsche Antwort auf den globalen Wettbewerb", erklärte Kamieth. Vor dem Hintergrund wachsender Konkurrenz aus Asien und dem Nahen Osten müsse sich die deutsche Industrie konsolidieren, bevor sie von ausländischen Investoren aufgekauft werde.

item.title: Meta falls as investors balance Muse growth with rising AI costs
item.description: Shares of Meta Platforms fell more than 5% in early trading on Thursday, as investors weighed the benefits of the company's fast-growing AI agent business against the mounting costs of funding its ambitious AI expansion.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shares of Meta Platforms (META.O) fell more than 5% in early trading on Thursday, as investors weighed the benefits of the company's fast-growing AI agent business against the mounting costs of funding its ambitious AI expansion. As of Wednesday's close, the stock had gained more than 5% this year. If current losses hold, Meta is set to shed about $85 billion in market value. The downbeat reaction comes despite Meta reporting stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue, forecasting fourth-quarter sales above Wall Street estimates and highlighting rapid adoption of its new [USN:L6N4500XV TEXT:"AI agent app, Muse"] The earnings report came hours after a New Mexico judge ordered the company to pay a [USN:L6N4671C7 TEXT:"$25 billion penalty"] in a data-privacy case linked to Cambridge Analytica. Meta said it plans to appeal the ruling The Instagram parent is [USN:L4N4671S3 TEXT:"spending heavily"] to support its AI plans, with an expected annual capital expenditure forecast between $135 billion and $145 billion. It also reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow a year earlier Deutsche Bank analyst Benjamin Black said Meta's AI investments were generating stronger advertising performance and engagement, creating a "positive thesis creep" around the stock as investors increasingly view computing infrastructure as a revenue-generating asset rather than a cost burden Meta also announced plans to create a new class of non-voting Class C shares, giving the company additional flexibility for acquisitions and employee compensation while preserving CEO Mark Zuckerberg's voting control At least 13 brokerages have raised their price targets on the stock after the results, according to data compiled by LSEG Concerns about the scale of Meta's AI investments have also spilled into [USN:L4N4681E6 TEXT:"credit markets"], with the cost of insuring the company's debt against default widening to a record high

(Corrects annual percentage yield to 4.4 per cent from 4.2 per cent in paragraph 2 after company revised the figure) By Niket Nishant and Manya Saini Oct 22 : SoFi Technologies on Thursday launched a "tokenized deposit" product that lets customers earn interest on cash set aside for crypto purchases, while offering protections similar to those of a traditional bank deposit. Cash held in a SoFi Earn account will generate 4.4 per cent annual interest and be insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, which protects eligible deposits of up to $250,000 per depositor if a bank fails.

"Too much money in the digital asset ecosystem is sitting idle, leaving massive potential earnings on the table for millions of people," SoFi CEO Anthony Noto told Reuters. The product moves SoFi into a space historically dominated by non-bank crypto firms. In recent years, funds earmarked for crypto trading were often parked in interest-bearing stablecoins, giving investors a way to earn yield while keeping money ready to deploy. That model has come under pressure after the GENIUS Act, signed last year, barred stablecoin issuers from paying interest, creating an opening for banks to offer regulated, interest-bearing alternatives through products such as tokenized deposits. SoFi Earn will also let users buy crypto directly or transfer funds to another platform. "The primary opportunity is with people who already participate in crypto and want that money to keep working and ready to move," Noto said. Traditional financial institutions are developing products to tap the crypto market, arguing that bank-issued alternatives offer greater regulatory oversight than stablecoins issued by non-bank entities. In September, a group of 21 financial institutions including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi and Deutsche Bank, said they planned to create a company this year to issue a dollar-pegged cryptocurrency in the first half of 2027. "Over the next year or so, you're going to see an inflection point. It is a big effort to move traditional finance on chain, but I think the economic drivers are just so powerful that it's inevitable," said Sam MacPherson, CEO at digital asset finance firm Spark.

Saudi Aramco tells staff to evacuate Dhahran as clashes with Yemen’s Houthis continue

Reuters

Oct 22 (Reuters) – Saudi state oil company Aramco has ordered the evacuation of its headquarters in Dhahran, six people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters on Thursday, as fighting between the world’s largest crude exporter and Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis intensifies.

Clashes between the Houthis and a Saudi-led coalition that backs Yemen’s internationally recognised government have raged since the group pushed towards Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a shipping chokepoint at the Red Sea’s mouth.

The instruction to staff to evacuate the building and work remotely follows a wave of Houthi attacks on the kingdom, targeting the company and Saudi airports. The company did not immediately respond to a request for comment on what would be the first evacuation since the start of the Iran war.

Show Full Article

It was unclear what the reason for the evacuation was.

The kingdom’s benchmark index .TASI dropped 2.5% on Thursday following the Aramco news, according to LSEG data.

The renewed fighting between Saudi Arabia and Houthi militias in recent weeks ended a 2022 UN-brokered truce, which had largely halted cross-border attacks, and opened another front in the US-Israeli war on Iran.

The Saudi-led coalition said on Thursday it had intercepted drones over Riyadh and Islam’s holy city of Medina.

The Houthis caused extensive damage to Aramco’s headquarters earlier this month when they struck the building, with fire spreading across several floors.

Saudi Arabia has responded to Houthi attacks with a wave of strikes on missile launcher sites, vowing to protect the kingdom, and says it has intercepted many ballistic missiles fired by the group.

Houthis military spokesperson Yahya Saree said on Thursday that the group is rescuing a boat carrying 14 Indians that was attacked off Jabal Zuqar island near the strait, one of the territories the group seized in an advance in September.

Saree blamed the attack on Saudi Arabia. Saudi authorities did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.

HOUTHI AIRPORT ATTACKS

A Houthi attack on King Fahd International Airport in Saudi Arabia’s eastern oil hub of Dammam near Dhahran on Wednesday evening killed two people, a Saudi citizen and an Indian national, and wounded eight others.

Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation said on Thursday that operations at the airport had resumed and air traffic had returned to normal.

The Houthis had warned airlines this month against using Saudi airspace as they have repeatedly targeted Saudi airports, including Riyadh’s international airport.

(Reporting by Timour Azhari, Marwa Rashad, Olesya Astakhova, Dmitry Zhdannikov, and Maha El Dahan,Nayera Abdallah, Tala Ramadan, Ahmed Tolba; Writing by Nayera AbdallahEditing by Peter Graff, Ros Russell, Philippa Fletcher)

item.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ 攻撃試行は数百万件に
item.description: [東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＰＨＰ脆弱性、世界で修正急ぐ　攻撃試行は数百万件に 10/22 20:42 配信

英機関によるＰＨＰの脆弱性への警告、22日撮影 REUTERS/Toby Melville

[東京／北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 世界各国の企業や政府は２２日、広く利用されているプログラミング言語「ＰＨＰ」で見つかった重大な脆弱性の修正を急いだ。サイバーセキュリティー企業によると、脆弱性の公表後に確認されたハッキングの試みは数百万件に及ぶ。

前日の２１日には、ウェブサイト運営者がＰＨＰを使うシステムの安全確保に追われる中、欧州などの政府が予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止した。ＰＨＰの開発者は、人工知能（ＡＩ）によって発見されるまで何年も潜んでいた脆弱性の緊急修正プログラムを公開、利用者に「直ちに更新する」よう呼びかけた。

世界各国で銀行、航空、鉄道、税務、行政のサービスが緊急停止し、公共・企業システムのＰＨＰへの依存度の高さと、脆弱性が明らかになった後に迅速に修正する難しさを示した。

マイクロソフトのサティア・ナデラ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２２日、ドイツのケルンで開いた同社のイベントで「ＩＴやセキュリティーに携わる全ての人にとって、長い一日、長い夜だったと思う。これほどの事態は長らく見たことがない」と語った。

今回の事態は、安全に保守が可能なデジタルシステム構築の重要性を浮き彫りにしたと述べた。

ベルギーのサイバーセキュリティー企業アイキドウ ・セキュリティーの共同創業者、マデリン・ローレンス氏は「修正プログラムの準備が整う前に脆弱性の詳細が公になり、攻撃が報告されている」と説明。「攻撃に備え企業は更新を急いでいる。まさに時間との競争だ」と語った。

クラウドサービス企業クラウドフレアによると、企業や政府が修正プログラムを適用し、予防措置としてウェブサイトを停止する中、ハッキングの試みは数百万件に急増した。

同社のマシュー・プリンスＣＥＯは２１日夜、「公表前の１０時間に、当社のネットワーク全体で脆弱性を悪用しようとする試みを数千件確認した」とＸに投稿。「公表後４５分で数万件、２時間以内に数十万件に跳ね上がり、今では数百万件に達している」とした。

日本では野村ホールディングス、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ、ＡＮＡホールディングス、ＪＲ東日本などが２２日、緊急措置の一環として一部のインターネットサービスを一時停止すると発表した。

東京海上ホールディングスは、グループ会社のウェブサイトを停止したと明らかにした。

財務省と気象庁は安全対策を実施するためオンラインサービスを一部停止し、国税庁もサービスを一時停止した。

予防的な停止措置は、日本でサイバーセキュリティーへの懸念が高まっていることを示している。トレンドＡＩのデータによると、２０２６年１─９月に日本で記録されたサイバーインシデントの件数は、２５年通年を上回った。

フランスの通信大手オレンジは、予防措置として、複数の子会社でＰＨＰを使う一部のウェブサイトやアプリケーションへのアクセスを一時停止したと説明した。

中国のクラウドサービス大手テンセントクラウドは、更新版のＰＨＰを導入するよう顧客に呼びかけたが、広範なウェブサイト停止を求めるには至らなかった。

フィンランドの政府ＩＴサービス機関バルトリは、前日に政府の一般向けウェブサービスを停止した後、夜間もＰＨＰのセキュリティー修正プログラムの適用を続け、予防的なサービス停止を段階的に解除していると説明した。「更新に加えてシステムを慎重にテストする必要があるため、サービスの復旧には数日、場合によっては数週間かかる可能性がある」と声明で述べた。

同機関は、サービス停止は脆弱性の悪用やサイバー侵害によるものではなく、脆弱性が実際に悪用された事例も把握していないと説明した。

アジアの複数の政府は２２日、ＰＨＰの脆弱性に関連するサイバーセキュリティー点検を指示した。

中国の工業情報省は、組織や利用者にシステムを直ちに点検し、安全性が確保された最新のＰＨＰに更新するよう呼びかけた。また、サイバーセキュリティー監視を強化し、必要に応じてアカウント、パスワード、鍵（キー） を変更するよう勧告した。

韓国はハッキング攻撃のリスク増大への懸念を理由に、民間部門のサイバーセキュリティー警戒レベルを引き上げ、緊急対応措置を発動した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：米中間選挙目前、ドル円の行方を読む＝高島修氏 アングル：ロシア、欧州企業への圧力強化、米企業は優遇 アングル：接戦のテキサス上院選は民主に勝機、共和が大量資金投入でてこ入れ 焦点：「ミュトス」登場で米銀はシステム修正に奔走、サービスに影響も コラム：サイバー攻撃のリスク、顧客だけでなく保険業界も動揺 最終更新: 10/22(木) 20:42 ロイター

item.title: ロシアとウクライナ攻撃応酬、ゼレンスキー氏「ロシアはクラスター弾頭使用」
item.description:
Olena Harmash Gleb Bryanski
[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olena Harmash　Gleb Bryanski

[キーウ／モスクワ ２２日 ロイター] - ロシアは２２日未明にかけてキーウを弾道ミサイルで激しく攻撃し、ウクライナはモスクワに向けて数百機の無人機（ドローン）を飛ばした。米国が戦争終結に向けて新たな働きかけを行っているが、両国は攻撃の応酬を続けている。

ウクライナ側は、ロシアが３波にわたり少なくとも２１発の弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表した。ロシア側は、ウクライナが夜間に首都モスクワに向けて無人機６３０機を発射したとしている。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアがクラスター弾頭を搭載した弾道ミサイル３発で首都キーウを攻撃したと明らかにした。ゼレンスキー氏によると、こうしたミサイルは目標に接近すると空中で爆発し、直径約４００メートルの範囲に被害を及ぼすよう設計されている。１発がキーウの歴史地区に着弾し、世界遺産「キーウ・ペチェールシク大修道院」の修道院近くが直撃を受けたという。

ベラルーシの国営ベルタ通信によると、双方は戦死者の遺体を交換し、ロシアが２５２人、ウクライナが２５人の遺体を引き渡した。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、ノルウェーの首都オスロでゼレンスキー氏のほか、欧州、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の当局者と会談した後、ロシアのプーチン大統領とサンクトペテルブルクで会談した。

ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官は「米国側は（オスロで）いくつかの新たな変化を感じ取り、われわれに伝えた。しかし、そうした変化はわれわれが十分に満足できるものではない」と述べた。

プーチン氏とウィットコフ氏の会談結果について説明を受けたロシア高官によると、会談は比較的短く、踏み込んだ議論はなかった。ウィットコフ氏はオスロでまとめた一連の提案をプーチン氏に手渡し、検討するよう求めたという。

ロシア大統領府に近い別の関係者によると、米国の提案には、ウクライナがドンバス地域全域をロシアに割譲する見返りに、ＮＡＴＯから将来の安全の保証を受ける案が含まれていた。

＜米特使「プーチン氏は人道主義者」と称賛、ウクライナは反発＞

ゼレンスキー氏は２２日、ウィットコフ氏がロシア訪問中にプーチン氏を「人道主義者」とたたえたことに反発した。ウィットコフ氏は、ウクライナでロシア軍に拘束されていた７４歳の米国人の解放について、プーチン氏に謝意を示していた。

ゼレンスキー氏はＸに「昨夜以降、ロシアの『人道主義者たち』がキーウに３波にわたって弾道ミサイルを発射した」と投稿した。「２１発のミサイルが使われた。残念ながら市内の多数の場所が被弾し、被害を受けた」と述べた。ウクライナの１０以上の地域が攻撃され、２人が死亡、子ども５人を含む３４人が負傷したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアは引き続きウクライナのエネルギーインフラを標的にしており、１１日以降、重要なエネルギー施設に対する攻撃が１７０件を超えたとしている。

ロシアはオデーサ州の港湾インフラとウクライナ軍が使用する船舶に対し、夜間に「大規模攻撃」を実施したと発表した。

ロシアでは、ウクライナのドローンによりモスクワ近郊で２人が負傷したと、ソビャニン市長が通信アプリ「テレグラム」で明らかにした。ドローンの大半は遠方で撃墜されたという。

ウクライナと国境を接するベルゴロド州では、ウクライナのドローン攻撃で男性１人が死亡、別の１人が負傷したと地元当局者が明らかにした。

item.title: French debt risk premium reaches euro zone sovereign crisis levels
item.description: The premium investors demand to buy France's 10-year government bonds against safe-haven Bunds reached a fresh 15-year high.
item.dc:creator: Stefano Rebaudo
item.content:encoded: The premium investors demand to buy France's 10-year government bonds against safe-haven Bunds reached a fresh 15-year high on Thursday as concerns about the country's ability to repair its public finances, coupled with ongoing street protests, continued to weigh on sentiment. French ministers have promised a vastly [USN:L1N4670D4 TEXT:"reinforced security operation"] during more planned protests this coming Saturday, with troops expected to be deployed alongside additional police. France's benchmark 10-year yield rose 11.5 basis points (bps) to 5.11%, after reaching 5.1415%, its highest level since July 2002. That pushed the French risk premium over German Bunds up to 173.58 - its widest since November 2011 during the euro zone debt crisis - reflecting investor unease about France's current fiscal outlook. Political uncertainty ahead of next year's presidential election in France and Paris' [USN:L8N4660JK TEXT:"difficulties in passing a budget"] have further weighed on market sentiment. "There exists a consensus that Europe is better equipped today to deal with crises, and that European institutions are stronger today than they were 15 years ago, which should make a European response easier to put together," Giada Giani, an economist at Citi, said, referring to differences between France today and euro zone periphery countries in the early 2010s. "But re-emerging euroscepticism is a constraint here," she added. The selloff in French government bonds persisted despite data showing [USN:S8N44Z00L TEXT:"industrial sentiment improved"] in October. Charlotte de Montpellier, senior economist, France and Switzerland at ING, underlined that the rebound was a welcome surprise, recalling that when business confidence data was collected, the nature of the risk included political and financial consequences of social unrest. BUNDS RISE ON SAFE-HAVEN BIDS Borrowing costs have risen this year as higher energy prices fuelled expectations of a hawkish central bank response, putting pressure on the bonds of highly indebted countries such as France. Bets on European Central Bank rate hikes have been quite stable in the last few weeks at around three additional tightening moves by late 2027. Germany’s 10-year government bond yields , the euro area benchmark, were down 4 bps to 3.38%, supported by safe-haven demand, despite a rise in oil prices. [USN:L1N46801N TEXT:"Brent crude futures rallied"] over $2 a barrel on Thursday after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia, while natural gas prices were just off their highest since December 2022. Yield gaps over Bunds widened across the euro zone, with Belgium's spread widening more than 10 bps to 111.28 bps, its highest since 2012, while Italy's rose 10.5 bps to 123 bps, Spain's widened 7.5 bps to 71 bps and Greece's increased 8.5 bps to 102 bps. The German 2-year government bond yield , more sensitive to policy rate expectations, fell 0.5 bps to 3.08%. ECB chief Christine Lagarde said at the end of last month, when markets were pricing almost four hikes by late-2027, a [USN:L8N45K12P TEXT:"moderate policy response"] from the ECB remained appropriate. Expectations for the ECB's rate path edged higher, with money markets pricing the deposit rate at 3.26% by late 2027, up from the current 2.50%, while expectations for December stood at 2.73%.

item.title: P&G warns of bigger cost hit from oil prices, even as consumer demand holds up
item.description: Procter & Gamble on Thursday warned that rising raw material, energy and freight costs would take a bigger bite out of annual profit, even as resilient demand for its beauty and home-care products drove first-quarter sales.
item.dc:creator: Juveria Tabassum, Alexander Marrow
item.content:encoded: Procter & Gamble (PG.N) on Thursday warned that rising raw material, energy and freight costs would take a bigger bite out of annual profit, even as resilient demand for its beauty and home-care products drove first-quarter sales. The Tide detergent and Pantene shampoo maker now expects increased costs to reduce fiscal 2027 profit by about $1.4 billion, up from its previous estimate of $1 billion. Pressures from high commodity costs are expected to increase over the next two quarters, Chief Financial Officer Andre Schulten said on a media call. Still, shares of P&G rose about 5% after the company posted better-than-expected first-quarter results. Commodity inflation has become a growing concern across industries, from [USN:L4N45U0P6 TEXT:"consumer goods giants"] to [USN:L4N4661G9 TEXT:"airlines"], as oil-price volatility following the US war on Iran pushes up fuel and transportation costs. "P&G's results suggest the consumer is holding up better than feared," said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management. The company's results offer a gauge of the resilience of US consumer spending as higher fuel and food costs squeeze household budgets and push shoppers towards cheaper alternatives. P&G also maintained its annual forecasts for organic sales growth of 1% to 3% and core earnings of roughly $7 per share. Schulten pointed to rising gasoline prices, continued volatility in the Middle East and inventory shifts as reasons for caution, saying the company did not want to "get ahead of ourselves." He said 3% growth would be "healthy" in the current environment. HIGHER COSTS SQUEEZE MARGINS P&G's core operating margin fell 80 basis points in the quarter ended September 30 despite 250 basis points of [USN:L3N3S80IG TEXT:"productivity savings"], including efforts to streamline its supply chain under new CEO Shailesh Jejurikar. Progress will not be a "straight line," and volatility will remain a mid-term reality, CFO Schulten said on a post-earnings call. Higher [USN:L1N460114 TEXT:"fuel prices"] have pushed up transportation and freight costs for packaged-goods companies, while a shortage of truck drivers on some routes has added pressure, a P&G spokesperson told Reuters. US [USN:L6N45Z19G TEXT:"retail diesel prices"] hit a record $6 a gallon in September following the US war in Iran and have remained elevated. P&G was trying to raise prices alongside product innovation, without jeopardizing top-line growth, Schulten said. RESILIENT DEMAND LIFTS VOLUMES First-quarter net sales rose 4% to $23.28 billion, beating analysts' estimates of $22.80 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Its shares rose about 5% in early trading. Volumes increased in P&G's beauty business, helped by demand for higher-priced hair-care products as consumers continued to spend on self-care despite pressure on household budgets from higher fuel and food costs. Overall volumes rose 2.4%, while prices increased about 0.4% in the three months through September. Swiss packaged-goods maker Nestle (NESN.S) also topped estimates for organic sales growth on Thursday, helped by stronger volumes. P&G's first-quarter core earnings of $2 per share beat estimates of $1.88.

item.title: Comcast flags over $1 billion in restructuring charges in fourth quarter
item.description: Comcast on Thursday flagged more than $1 billion in charges for the fourth quarter as it changes its organizational structure, ahead of the planned spinoff of its NBCUniversal business in mid-2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Comcast (CMCSA.O) on Thursday flagged more than $1 billion in charges for the fourth quarter as it changes its organizational structure, ahead of the planned spinoff of its NBCUniversal business in mid-2027. The company lost more broadband customers than expected in the third quarter as fierce competition chipped away at its core business, while NBCUniversal benefited from gains in theatrical and streaming. Shares of the company were up 3% in early trading. Here are more details: Broadband users decreased by 144,000 in the third quarter, the company said, compared with the 116,800 losses estimated by analysts polled by FactSet and the 91,000 decrease reported in the year-ago period Comcast's studios, theme parks and Peacock streaming service are set to separate from the company as part of the planned NBCUniversal spinoff Comcast is [USN:L4N46723Z TEXT:"reportedly"] planning a significant number of layoffs to restructure its connectivity business "The Odyssey" was a bright spot for Universal Studios, becoming the highest-grossing film in its history and helping drive pre-tax profit up 18.6% for the unit The media division posted a 13% increase in third-quarter revenue to $5.36 billion, driven by soccer World Cup programming and "Love Island USA" on Peacock Peacock reported a quarterly pre-tax profit of $261 million, compared with a $217 million loss a year ago NBCUniversal's theme park unit is seeing weaker demand in Orlando, while geopolitical tensions continue to deter Chinese tourists from visiting its parks in Japan, which is a major market The segment reported a 4.4% decline in revenue to $2.60 billion, missing analysts' average estimate of $2.71 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG Comcast reported an adjusted profit of $1.07 per share, above analysts' average estimate of 98 cents

Nebius gets $3.5 billion Citi facility for data center growth

A view shows detail of racks for data servers, GPUs and CPUs inside the Nebius AI UK data centre, a new facility hosting NVIDIA and other computer firms, at Ark Data Centres, in Chertsey, Britain, November 6, 2025. REUTERS/Toby Melville

AMSTERDAM, Oct 22 : AI cloud services firm Nebius on Thursday said it had secured a $3.5 billion financing facility from Citi to fund continued development of its data centres and GPU purchases as it races to expand capacity. The announcement comes against the backdrop of a selloff in shares last week related to AI infrastructure, after bonds issued by rival CoreWeave fell sharply in value. CoreWeave is usually grouped with Nebius as among the top "neocloud" firms that are building data centres specialized for AI. The new Nebius facility matures in 364 days and carries an initial interest rate of 2.75 per cent over the term SOFR benchmark rate. The Amsterdam-based company said the financing would give it greater flexibility over the timing and structure of further fundraising to support growth in 2027 and beyond. Its funding sources also include customer prepayments and operating cash flow. Chief Operating Officer Ophir Nave said Nebius had other financing options available, including borrowing against more than $40 billion in long-term contracts with investment-grade customers, which include Microsoft and Meta . "This facility provides additional financing to support our near-term capacity build-out," Nave said in a statement. The company has around $10 billion in convertible bond debt outstanding following a $5.75 billion issue in August.

Source: Reuters

item.title: UK regulator urges pension trustees to stress-test over AI concentration risk
item.description: British pension funds could have greater exposure to AI-related risks than trustees realise, Britain's pensions regulator said on Thursday, and urged them to challenge advisers on how a market downturn could affect their portfolios.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British pension funds could have greater exposure to AI-related risks than trustees realise, Britain's pensions regulator said on Thursday, and urged them to challenge advisers on how a market downturn could affect their portfolios. In a statement the Pensions Regulator, or TPR, said AI was increasingly embedded across sectors, meaning even an apparently diversified portfolio could have "hidden exposure". It said trustees should assess both direct and indirect AI-related exposure across asset classes and stress-test how portfolios would perform under severe market stress. Ben Gunnee, executive director of market oversight at the TPR, said all pension schemes must maintain standards of investment governance and manage risk over the short, medium and long term. “That is why trustees should assess their AI-related exposure, test portfolio resilience and challenge advisers now to understand how market developments could affect their investments under different market conditions,” he said in a statement. The Bank of England in a report in July also flagged the risk of a lack transparency in some AI funding arrangements may make it hard to identify the extent of the issue, meaning any selloff in highly valued AI stocks could have a very broad impact. Global corporate investment in AI-related activity more than doubled in 2025, according to the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence's 2026 AI Index Report.

As weight-loss drug users turn to dietary supplements, doctors, regulators raise flags

By Nicholas P. Brown NEW YORK, Oct 20 (Reuters) – For Allison Vecchio, 42, GLP-1 drugs were “a reset button on life,” but at a price — side effects like gastrointestinal distress, brittle nails, and feelings of weakness so intense that at times she could not leave her bed.

But the Fort Pierce, Florida-based ER nurse said the symptoms eased when she began a cocktail of supplements that included fiber, collagen and electrolytes, a haul that costs $200 to $300 a month. “You really have to take the reins” to turn mere weight loss into improved health, she said.

GLP-1 drugs like Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy rank among the biggest medical breakthroughs in years, owing to their efficacy in treating obesity and type 2 diabetes, and reducing the risk of heart disease. Some 10 million Americans used them last year, a figure that could grow to 25 million by 2030, according to JPMorgan research.

Show Full Article

Their side effects, though, have caused many to turn to loosely regulated dietary supplements.

US supplement sales have surged in recent years, surpassing $74 billion in 2025, according to the Nutrition Business Journal. While users swear by them, their growing popularity — fueled in part by social media — has doctors raising red flags and regulators considering new rules around how these products come to market.

Vitamins and supplements don’t need preapproval by the US Food and Drug Administration, making their scientific credibility hard to gauge. With social media personalities playing a growing role in their promotion, some medical researchers have called for more regulation of online supplement marketing.

Rob Fried, CEO of Niagen Bioscience, which had $129 million in sales last year, cautioned that companies “can hire an influencer, or even hundreds of influencers on TikTok … to make whatever claims will sell.”

SALES OF SUPPLEMENTS SOAR

Vecchio has 25,000 TikTok followers and is on retainer with three brands. She is also a member of TikTok Shop’s HealthPro creator program, which is reserved for licensed health professionals.

Pittsburg, Kansas, resident Terri Hart, 52 — a TikToker with more than 12,000 followers — mostly works on commission, perusing products the brands make available to influencers, and promoting the ones she feels helped her the most.

Hart takes magnesium, electrolytes, B12 and other supplements, which she says have helped offset what she called “horrible” nausea, fatigue and constipation after beginning GLP-1s in 2023. They run about $110 a month, costs insurance doesn’t cover. TikTok income eases the burden, Hart says.

She says she makes clear she isn’t a medical professional, and urges followers to talk to doctors before taking her advice. “I establish my authority through my lived experience,” Hart said.

TikTok Shop generated more than $1 billion in dietary supplement sales in 2025, or 5.4% of all e-commerce supplement sales, according to the Nutrition Business Journal, while overall US vitamin and supplement sales grew 5% in 2024 and 7% last year.

The drugs are “bringing in new consumers and expanding existing supplement routines,” said Erika Craft, a data analyst at Nutrition Business Journal.

But absent FDA preapproval, people don’t know exactly what is in many supplements, said Jonathan Bonnet, a clinical associate professor at Stanford and chief medical officer at the Ardmore Institute of Health in Ardmore, Oklahoma.

“If you can’t know what you’re taking, it’s hard to know what risks you’re undergoing,” he said.

RETAILERS OFFER MORE SUPPLEMENTS

Nearly half of GLP-1 users started taking new vitamins and supplements after beginning the drugs, according to a Nutrition Business Journal survey, with probiotics, protein and fiber particularly popular.

A consumer survey by Boston Consulting Group this year said GLP-1 users spend roughly 20% more on protein, fiber and collagen, a protein that helps maintain skin structure, than before starting the drugs.

Companies are capitalizing. Target is widening its supplement offerings, while private equity-owned The Vitamin Shoppe has seen double-digit sales growth this year in fiber and creatine, which are both popular with GLP-1 users, said Jack Gayton, senior vice president of merchandising at The Vitamin Shoppe.

Mergers and acquisitions in the space are getting bigger, though with fewer transactions. In 2024, there were 115 deals globally worth $7.3 billion, according to financial data firm PitchBook. In 2025, there were 95 deals worth $16.9 billion. Through October 6 of this year, there have been 68 deals worth $14.6 billion.

Procter & Gamble is set to acquire supplement maker Thorne, while Japan’s Kirin Holdings announced in August it will buy Canada’s Jamieson Wellness, whose US-based brand youtheory released a product aimed at GLP-1 users in early 2025.

Jamieson spokesperson Ruth Winker said the company sees GLP-1s as a tailwind for growth beyond combating side effects. “As people get healthier, they tend to take more vitamins and supplements,” Winker said.

REGULATIONS IN THE OFFING

US Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has proposed tighter regulations. The FDA this year has stepped up efforts to strengthen oversight of new dietary ingredients, issuing new guidance on what submissions for review should include.

Many supplement makers avoid this review process by using a pathway that allows food companies to declare ingredients “generally recognized as safe” without notifying the FDA. But a proposed rule would eliminate that option as part of Kennedy’s broader effort to regulate food ingredients.

The proposal has divided the industry. Some support more regulation, lamenting unscrupulous actors who spike supplements with drugs or add only tiny amounts of touted beneficial ingredients.

“At a minimum, a review process should happen prior to launch,” says Jacqueline Maslan, CEO of Body of Work, a vitamin startup aimed at women under 40.

But supplement trade group the Council for Responsible Nutrition says the rule would cause months of backlogs as the FDA reviews thousands of ingredients.

Thorne CEO Colin Watts said it’s “improbable” the FDA could have the manpower to review new ingredients “at the speed needed to keep up with innovation.”

In a statement to Reuters, an HHS spokesperson said the FDA is mulling opportunities “to modernize its regulatory approach to keep pace with an evolving marketplace,” adding the agency wants to ensure product safety “while supporting consumer choice.”

(Reporting by Nicholas P. Brown; Additional reporting by Neil J Kanatt in Bengaluru, Editing by Christian Plumb, Lisa Jucca and David Gaffen)

item.title: スポティファイ、予想上回る第4四半期営業益見込む ＡＩ機能で
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは２２日、第４・四半期の営業利益が８億２０００万ユー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スポティファイ、予想上回る第4四半期営業益見込む　ＡＩ機能で 10/22 19:55 配信

スポティファイのロゴ、ニューヨーク証券取引所のフロアで2023年撮影 REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

[２２日 ロイター] - スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは２２日、第４・四半期の営業利益が８億２０００万ユーロ（９億２０５３万ドル）になるとの見通しを示し、アナリスト予想の８億１３４０万ユーロを上回った。人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した機能を背景に、ホリデーシーズンにおけるユーザー数の拡大を見込んでいる。

同社の株価はプレマーケット取引で３％以上上昇した。

スポティファイは、音声コメント付きのパーソナライズされた音楽ミックスをキュレートする「AI DJ」や、ユーザーが気分や好みの音楽を説明することで、それに合わせた選曲を生成するプロンプトベースのプレイリストなど、ＡＩを活用した機能を提供。ＡＩへの投資を進めているため、投資家は同社の収益性を注視している。

第３・四半期の営業利益は６億７２００万ユーロと、アナリスト予想の６億７１８０万ユーロとほぼ一致。売上高は４９億７０００万ユーロで、予想は４９億８０００万ユーロだった。

同社は、成長が持続的に加速する強固なビジネスを構築しているとして、「今後もさらなる成長の余地がある」と述べた。

第４・四半期における月間アクティブユーザー数（ＭＡＵ）見通しは８億１８００万人。市場予想の８億１９００万人をわずかに下回った一方、プレミアム加入者数が１０００万人増加して３億１６００万人に達するという見通しは、予想の３億１４７０万人を上回った。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か コラム：米アップル、ＥＶ断念でもＡＩによる収益化期待揺るがず 最終更新: 10/22(木) 20:01 ロイター

FAST

Oct 22 : Tesla's shares fell 2 per cent on Thursday after the EV maker cut its capital spending forecast, raising concerns among investors counting on heavy investment for Elon Musk's AI and robotics vision. The company on Wednesday lowered its 2026 capital spending forecast to about $20 billion from more than $25 billion after spending far less than expected on AI and robotics in the third quarter, which led to a surprise positive free cash flow. The strong position may prove valuable as CEO Musk explores combining Tesla with the far more capital-intensive SpaceX. Capex is a delicate balance in this market, said Josh Gilbert, lead analyst at etoro. Investors welcome a larger budget if they can see returns, but a smaller one hints at slowing growth, he added.

"For a stock priced on Cybercab and Optimus, that (capex forecast cut) explains why the shares went nowhere on a result that beat on most measures." Tesla did not break down the areas that would see spending cuts and the leadership on Wednesday attributed the adjustment to managing capital deployment efficiently. Tesla's shares have declined about 14 per cent this year, in contrast to the Nasdaq's roughly 15 per cent gain. The stock is about 23 per cent below its record intraday high of $498.83, reached in December. Its valuation, however, remains well above peers: Tesla traded at 188.24 times its forward earnings estimates, compared with 6.58 for Ford and 5.16 for General Motors. Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees to discuss a potential mega-merger, Musk said on Tuesday. The move could create an AI, cars, satellites and rockets behemoth worth about $3.5 trillion. "The risk is Tesla now enters a period of limbo while investors await news on a potential combination with SpaceX, which ... might face significant regulatory hurdles," said Russ Mould, investment director at AJ Bell.

Source: Reuters
